title: Sindhu Rues Unforced Errors in French Open Final Loss
indian_angle: P.V. Sindhu, India's top women's singles player, reached a significant final at the French Open, demonstrating her continued presence at the sport's elite level.
summary: P.V. Sindhu reflected on her French Open final loss to world No. 1 An Se-young, citing unforced errors and the high intensity required against such a formidable opponent, especially when an 8-5 lead slipped in the decisive third game.

title: India's French Open 2026 Performance: Sindhu's Final, Ashmita's Upset
